name: Morocco
famous_for: Jemaa el-Fnaa square in Marrakech, blue-washed streets of Chefchaouen, Sahara sand dunes of Merzouga, and aromatic Tagines.
tourists: Over 14.5M international visitors annually; famous for Medina of Fez (oldest university), Hassan II Mosque, and Atlas mountains.
must_know: Moroccan mint tea is served poured from high above the glass to create a foamy crown, known with affection as 'Berber whiskey'.
fun_fact: The University of al-Qarawiyyin in Fez, founded in 859 AD by Fatima al-Fihri, is the oldest operating university in the world.
